title: Edge Watch to Superman transport integration test
hypothesis: Transport and ingestion path should accept a valid packet without proposing a strategy change.
mechanism: Valid schema packet marked REJECT exercises remote fetch, schema validation, deduplication, receipt creation and safe classification only.
exact_rule_or_model_spec: No trading rule. Integration test only.
expected_benefit: Verify end-to-end research packet transport safely.
risks: None to trading because recommended_action is REJECT and all deployment permissions are false.
falsification_criteria: Bridge does not fetch, validate, deduplicate, classify, or receipt the packet.
validation_plan: Fetch through the public raw feed and verify one receipt with classification REJECT; repeat fetch must deduplicate.
